Final result: \(\Delta S=57.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{res}}=-50.00\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), and \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{univ}}=7.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\).

Final answer:
\(\Delta S=57.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{res}}=-50.00\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), and \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{univ}}=7.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\).
